title: P6-12: Threat Intelligence: DNS cutover of threat-intelligence.anth.us and its staging host, Anth.us proof, rollback
description:
## Goal
A human runbook for Ryan retires the Threat Intelligence legacy copies after the two-week sign-off: the legacy new-template app (dzefa11i80jyq) and the inert OLD app (d3on1y5vlrxmam) with its research data archived first.

## Context (FACT)
- Legacy items: app dzefa11i80jyq, stack amplify-app-shell-threat-intelligence-cms, backend stack amplify-dzefa11i80jyq-main-branch-a099beb80d (pool us-east-1_t1A6sJX55 with domain papyrus-threat-intelligence, 11 content models, 65 media objects), roles threat-intelligence-github-ci / papyrus-authoring, SSM /amplify/dzefa11i80jyq/... and /papyrus/threat-intelligence/revalidate-secret; the OLD app d3on1y5vlrxmam (no associations) with backend stack amplify-d3on1y5vlrxmam-main-branch-aeb7dfa526, pool us-east-1_lAtce7ZTu, 39 tables including the research data (Reference 1866, SemanticRelation 3258, SemanticNode 387, Message 907, ReferenceAttachment 626, ModelAttachment 585, ...), media bucket 1004 objects 254 MB (corpora/ 409 objects 88 MB). Research data is archive-only (Ryan 2026-10-07).
- DANGER (PPY-52d455 D2): deleting the legacy association of dzefa11i80jyq (or the app) may delete the two CNAMEs by name, which now point at the new app. Use the behaviour proven by p.apyr.us (PPY-343fea) or hold the saved UPSERT batches and re-apply them in the same minute. Do not touch `_61eb...` (six associations' renewal record) or anything else in the shared zone.

## Exact steps
1. Pre-checks after the sign-off: new app healthy for two weeks; baseline re-run equals; zone diff clean.
2. ARCHIVE the research data BEFORE any deletion: export the 39 old tables (DynamoDB export or paged scan to JSON) and the old bucket (`corpora/`, `newsroom/`, `media/`) to an S3 bucket in papyrus-production or a local encrypted archive Ryan chooses; verify counts and bytes; record the location in this ticket.
3. Write the runbook (account assertions, order: stop legacy auto-build; delete the legacy association with the restore batches ready; delete apps; delete the app-shell stack; delete backend stacks; remove legacy Google entries (`papyrus-threat-intelligence`, old pool hex) from the TI client; remove the old per-account roles and parameters; keep the shared zone untouched). Irreversible steps marked.
4. Ryan runs it; after each step verify the two TI hosts and the Anth.us proof hashes.

## Acceptance checks
- TI hosts serve from the new app; Anth.us proof hashes and the other four apps' associations unchanged; archive verified before the old backend delete.

## Rollback
Before deletion switch the CNAMEs back. After deletion none (data is in production and in the archive).

## Needs Ryan
The sign-off, the archive location, every deletion.

## Common rules (Phase 6, PPY-7d8cd0)
- Read ~/Projects/Papyrus/AGENTS.local.md first. Assert the account with `aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text` before EVERY call: profile legacy = 335163751677, profile papyrus-production = 712236451410. Never use papyrus-development; papyrus-staging (494166748521) is not used by this phase.
- Every write needs Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step. Legacy is READ-ONLY except the steps this ticket names (each with a yes). No SCPs on legacy; never risk legacy access; no `cdk deploy` and no `ampx` against the legacy stacks of these sites.
- Never print secret values (names only; SSM values move by pipe, never to the terminal or a ticket). Ryan deletes retired resources. Do not touch Anth.us production d2hbn1ig6nqyhy or the other anth.us apps (apricity d2n7w4kwqyfwn4, babulus d3epcqvzbxdaq, tactus dfkbdffs2viq8, primus divicqm3nhcwt).
- Baselines and scratch live under ~/Projects/.baselines/phase6-<date>/ (outside any repo); clones go under ~/Projects/ and are deleted afterwards (disk is tight). Only kbs writes in the Papyrus checkout (never git add/commit there); never `git stash`.
- The committed infra/site.json in each site repo still describes the LEGACY stack until the cutover ticket; production deploys use an out-of-repo, domain-free copy (as PPY-aa93b3 did for p.apyr.us).
right_now_summary: The runbook awaits Ryan’s sign-off, archive location, and approval for each deletion step.
